title: Dedicated capacity scenario orchestrator — combined steady-state validation and rapid-burst resilience tests
creator: Asha Patel
description: Build an orchestrator that runs repeatable combined scenarios against Dedicated clusters: long steady-state token/s throughput validation (12+ hour soak) plus scheduled rapid-burst windows to exercise autoscaler and fallback policies. The orchestrator should be configurable, produce reproducible artifacts, and integrate with our regression detector for p95 and tail-latency alerts.
acceptance_criteria: Orchestrator can run a full scenario (steady + bursts) end-to-end against a dedicated pool from CI or manual trigger
Collected metrics include tokens/sec, p50/p95/p99 latency, request success rate, autoscaler decision timestamps, and KV cache hit ratios
Regression detector receives scenario results automatically and flags deviations beyond configured baselines
Run artifacts (perf traces, aggregated histograms, raw logs) are uploaded to S3 and linked in the run record
Playbook documented with run commands, expected runtime, and post-run checklist
plan_steps: Design traffic profile: steady-state 1200 tps-equivalent tokens/sec for 12 hours with randomized seed for prompt lengths
Schedule burst windows: 5 bursts at 3x steady for 90s each with 5-minute cool-downs between bursts
Implement scenario orchestrator as a k6/locust composite runner with an added controller service to emit burst events
Instrument runtime hooks to emit autoscaler decisions to a dedicated event stream for correlation
Integrate post-run job that aggregates histograms and posts to regression-detector endpoint
Add a CI job (pipeline) and a manual job in Console to trigger scenarios against a named dedicated pool
Run initial smoke test in staging, iterate on thresholds, then run a full night soak in canary Dedicated pool
thresholds_and_alerts: p95 latency > baseline * 1.25 => create SEV ticket and mark run as failed
error_rate > 0.5% sustained over 1 minute => abort burst window and notify SRE
autoscaler failed to add capacity within configured grace period (120s) during a burst => investigate policy
tokens_per_sec sustained drop > 10% compared to expected => create regression alert
KV cache hit ratio drop > 15 percentage points => add diagnostic trace and compare model variant cache keys
blockers: Need autoscaler event stream schema finalized (waiting on infra-autoscaler team PR review)
Staging Dedicated pool capacity limited this sprint; may require schedule change for full-length soak
decisions: Use a composite runner (k6 core for load + small Go controller) to avoid Locust's thread overhead for very long soaks
Prefer event-based autoscaler hooks rather than scraping logs for tighter correlation latencies
Store raw histograms in compressed JSON for deterministic diffs in the regression detector
